components: etcd-style coordination: reads and updates metadata
etcd-style coordination: holds leases and membership
etcd-style coordination: reacts to revision changes
links: replicate update to Coordination follower A
replicate update to Coordination follower B

steps: A client reads a key and its global revision.
A transaction compares that revision before atomically updating the key.
Ephemeral ownership attaches the key to a renewable lease.
Watchers consume ordered revisions and observe deletion when the lease expires.
